name: Doutei Danshi to Bichiko-chan ~Himitsu no Hame Pako Kagai Jugyou~
original_name: 童貞男子とビチ子ちゃん　～秘蜜のハメパコ課外授業～
source:
This is a story about a guy who is constantly rejected by girls.
One day, he spotted Maya doing compensated dating behind the school building, and accidentally pours his semen on her from the roof he was peeking from. Maya has found out about this and started scolding him, but then he has a realization that since Maya is a well-known slut in school, maybe she can teach him how to be popular with girls. Maya agrees to help him out if he buys her a bag she wants. And so begin Maya's naughty after-school sex lessons to turn the virgin guy into a ladies' man.
translation:
这是一个总被女孩拒绝的男人的故事。

某天，他在校舍后发现麻耶援交，自己却从偷窥的屋顶上不小心把精液射到她身上。麻耶发现后开始训斥他，但他意识到：麻耶是学校里出了名的荡妇，也许能教自己如何受女孩欢迎。麻耶同意帮助他，条件是他买给她想要的包。于是，麻耶开始了下流的放学后性爱课程，把处男训练成女人缘高手。
